author: /root/weak_pointwise_limit/radial_coefficient_bound
exact_results: For finite spectator dimension d, A(m,gamma) is an actual complex polynomial in Fin 3 coordinates homogeneous of degree m, with actual coefficient L1 bounded by M D^m S^(sum_i gamma_i).
The actual term at (X,s) is eval X (A m gamma) times product_i s_i^(gamma_i), indexed by Nat times (Fin d -> Nat).

For M,D,r,S,h nonnegative, D*r<1, S*h<1, and actual coordinate bounds norm X_i<=r and norm s_i<=h, the series is absolutely and complex summable, and the norm of its tsum is at most M / ((1-D*r)*(1-S*h)^d).
HasSumUniformlyOn is proved on the literal product of those two closed polydiscs, with the actual tsum as limit.
For shifted coefficient profile M D^(m+1) S^(sum gamma), the same conclusions hold with numerator M*D.
semantic_checks: Every convergence assertion is derived from the literal geometric majorant; no convergence conclusion is assumed as a hypothesis.
The spectator majorant is summed over actual finite-coordinate natural exponent functions, including dimension zero; its sum is the reciprocal denominator power.
Product summability is established before applying the product HasSum identity.
Zero degree, zero radii, zero D or S, and zero spectator dimension are included by the stated hypotheses and Lean natural-power conventions.
These are complex coordinate polydiscs with finite Pi coordinates; no unidentified physical Sobolev object is used.
review_disclosure: The author read the complete three final sources, all eight exact expanded declarations and all axiom reports, plus the full receipt. This is an author checkpoint, not an independent review.
validation: All three initial compiler runs and the strict v8 audit passed. All owned compiler and auditor jobs are terminal. One harmless unused-hypothesis warning appears in the monomial norm lemma.
limits: This proves double-index normal convergence and an explicit sum bound. It does not prove joint analyticity, identify the physical KS Taylor family, or discharge the whole R04/D5 obligation.
The shifted Q variant does not assert an original B_0=0 reindexing theorem for the double-index family.
No executable solver, certificate checker, spectral result, approximation rate for the physical state, or bit-complexity claim is made.
Existing pinned library and continuation object caches were reused. No isolated source dependency rebuild is claimed.

preservation.action: New continuation sources and checkpoint only; all PASS sources and historical artifacts preserved.
